hero.title: Realtime worlds, still frames, and the odd website.
hero.text: I build environments, systems, and visuals in Unreal — and whatever else the brief needs. Spare time is theoretical; the work is not.

about: I'm a Unreal Engine developer and 3D generalist. I like to make pretty things that run smooth. I'm mostly interested in realtime visualization, VR and technical stuff. I also dabble in graphics and web, and in my free time I like to take photos on my trips.

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence
ai.lede: I use AI every day, and I also hate it — here's how I actually use it:

items.title: Draw the line
items.text: Automate what can be automated, speed up what can be sped up — but draw a clear line before it spills into creativity or steers focus away.

items.title: Keep the craft
items.text: For creative work, authenticity matters most to me — and it’s something AI can’t, and shouldn’t, replace.

items.title: On the edge
items.text: I’m a tech enthusiast. I like pushing past what’s currently possible — peeking behind the curtain at what will come and how to utilise it.
